source_audits.source_name: Planning permissions on the London Development Database (LDD)
source_audits.publisher: Greater London Authority (GLA); data supplied by London planning authorities
source_audits.attribution_requirements: Attribute Greater London Authority, London Development Database, and relevant borough/planning authority; preserve OGL v3 notice.

coverage_years.archive_page: LDD archive covers permissions/live or completed since 2006-04-01, with the archived Datastore spreadsheets no longer updated after LDD replacement by Planning London Datahub.

source_audits.update_frequency: Archived one-off Datastore extract; not a current live feed.
source_audits.geographic_scope: Greater London; row-level point locations from LDD Easting/Northing fields.
source_audits.granularity: Planning permission / scheme row, with optional related non-residential floorspace and bedroom workbook rows by planning authority and borough reference.
key_fields_used: Date work commenced on site (Started Date)
required_caveats: LDD completion status is not direct evidence of opening, occupation, current use, public access, design quality, service delivery, outcomes, or causation.
Completion Date is source-supplied by/through planning authorities and should remain separate from permission, start, opening, and later-use dates.
Coordinates are approximate planning-database points, not footprints or surveyed entrances.
Candidate selection is intentionally high-signal and non-exhaustive; local planning documents should be consulted before canonical publication.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use as candidate observed-change records only, with visible row-level provenance and caveats.

selection_summary.dedupe_rule: Excluded LDD planning-permissions workbook rows already referenced by round124 candidates; generated round125 candidate IDs use planning authority and borough reference.
filters: Date construction completed (Completed Date) between 2008-01-01 and 2026-05-19
BNG Easting/Northing present and within broad Greater London bounds
selection_summary.score_notes: Score rewards public/civic terms, architecture/mixed-use/regeneration terms, and large proposed homes/floorspace/bedrooms/site-area thresholds; minor administrative terms are penalized.
known_gaps: No per-row web URL is present in the archive spreadsheets; row citation uses dataset URL, official download URL, workbook name, sheet, Excel row, planning authority, and borough reference.
The LDD archive does not itself prove opening/current use/outcomes.
This scratch pack is not an exhaustive London development completion dataset.
